question: Should schema version 10 and source-revision-first ordering become the supported upgrade and conflict-resolution contract for existing gitcrawl archives?
rationale: The patch and proof establish technical behavior, but only maintainers can accept the permanent stored-data semantics and compatibility burden for automatic upgrades.

options.title: Accept the contract
options.body: Approve schema 10 and the ordering semantics, then merge after the draft is marked ready.

options.title: Narrow the rollout
options.body: Split or gate migration-sensitive portions if the full persistence contract is too broad for the next release.

options.title: Keep the draft paused
options.body: Delay landing until a designated persistence owner is prepared to own long-term archive compatibility.

recommendation.title: Accept the contract
recommendation.body: Approve schema 10 and the ordering semantics, then merge after the draft is marked ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The released v0.7.1 persistence baseline makes this person the best available owner for accepting its replacement upgrade contract.
